questions.text: In The Enormous Carrot, what did the old man plant?
questions.discussion: The old man prepared the soil and planted carrot seeds. The story is about a carrot that grew very large.

questions.text: Why did the old man ask his family for help?
options: The carrot was too difficult to pull out alone.
questions.answer: The carrot was too difficult to pull out alone.
questions.discussion: The carrot had grown enormous. The old man could not pull it out by himself, so his family helped.

questions.text: Who helped the old man pull the enormous carrot?

questions.text: Which sequence is suitable for a simple gardening project?
options: Harvest, water, prepare the soil, and plant seeds.

Plant seeds, harvest, dig the soil, and prepare the soil.
Prepare the soil, plant seeds, water the plants, and harvest.
questions.answer: Prepare the soil, plant seeds, water the plants, and harvest.
questions.discussion: A simple gardening process begins by preparing the soil, then planting and caring for the plants. Harvesting comes when the vegetables are ready.

questions.text: Which sentence tells what the old man did first?
options: He asked his granddaughter for help.

questions.answer: He prepared the planting bed and dug the soil.
questions.discussion: Before planting, the old man prepared the planting bed and dug the soil. This is the beginning of the gardening process.
